hint.isekai_mahou.ambience_music: Ambient music is on · volume in Mods > Isekai Mahou > Config
command.isekai_mahou.ambience.music: Ambient music forced: %s (back to normal with /mahou ambience music auto)
Quiet dark fantasy music in dungeons, towers, cities, the Abyss and the Home Realm. Bosses keep their own music.
isekai_mahou.configuration.ambientMusicV: 0 to 100. The game's "Music" slider also applies. 0 = no ambient music.
isekai_mahou.configuration.spellSounds.t: Each element has its own sound on cast and on hit; bigger spell, bigger sound.
isekai_mahou.configuration.glowInDark.to: Crystals, runes and essences glow in the dark. Reload resources (F3+T) for a change to apply.
